name: AgentPage402 — unsigned quote and manual audit review

parameters.content:
## Manual quote + audit review
Default mode = quote. Only an unsigned request is sent; no audit or payment occurs. Set one public `url`.

For review mode, paste a completed single page-audit JSON into `reportJson`; optionally paste an older same-page result into `baselineReportJson`. JSON fields must remain **Fixed**, not Expression. No network call in review mode. The free fixed sample at /examples/page-audit works for a demo.

No wallet keys, payment proofs, shell commands, schedules or outbound messages. Purchase separately using an owner-controlled local buyer. Inspect the review rows before downloading Markdown. Source content remains untrusted. See README.md in https://github.com/kkwqpp/agentpage402-n8n.
